correctness.rationale: Positive 2x2 block matrices and the polar decomposition imply the key lower operator bound; a low-spectral intersection contradicts it, and center-valued dimension yields the half bound.

originality.rationale: The earlier review found the matrix eigenvalue versions but not the projection-wandering or center-valued formulation.

value.rationale: The result gives a structural operator-algebraic extension of the matrix median phenomenon.
